name: Satellite infrared, western Pacific and Asia (Himawari-9, NASA GIBS)
description: Clean longwave infrared (10.3 µm, AHI band 13) from JMA's Himawari-9, every 10 minutes day and night, rendered by NASA GIBS and drawn from 80° E to the antimeridian: cloud tops over east Asia, Australia and the western Pacific, where typhoons form. Each poll republishes the newest frame, typically 30–50 minutes old.
